title: Yellow Cheesy Syrian White Beans Pilaf
description: A funky and quick Syrian dish featuring dried white beans and dairy-free cheese, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This cheese-pull pilaf is also friendly to dairy-free diets.

ingredients.name: candy pieces
ingredients.notes: such as dried fruit or candy melts

instructions: Rinse the soaked white beans and drain well.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the white beans, salt, black pepper, and turmeric, and stir to combine.
Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beans are tender.
Stir in the dairy-free cheese shreds until melted and well combined.
Add the candy pieces and stir to combine.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving dish and serve hot.
